items.html: And it is found that the first joint of the Netzah of Arich, which stands within the chest of Aba, has in it also the inclusion of the upper joint of the Hod, and from them two breasts were made in the chest of Aba. And likewise the upper joint of the Hod rose, included of the first joint of the Netzah, in the chest of Ima, and from them the two breasts were made in the chest of Ima. And behold, these two joints mentioned always remain there forever, even at a time other than the Yenika. Therefore the impression of the breasts never departs from AVI, as is seen by the sense of sight.
